tasks.title: Security Hardening, Health Audit & Floorplan Integration
tasks.request: Install and operationalize haydenschmitty/floorplan as interactive codebase engine, resolve all health audit issues (secrets, support_enter, 60-hex tokens, dialer reaper), and verify all screens without orphaned services.
tasks.summary: Completed security audit fixes across controllers and dialer, eliminated all high-severity secret findings, achieved 0.0% unassigned files, and integrated Floorplan live export.

items.note: Restricted support_enter against self-entry and non-platform access; standardized rotate_secret to 60 hex characters.
Standardized legacy rotate_secret token generation to 60 hex characters (30 random bytes).
Added reapStaleLeases() to automatically release campaign contacts stuck in dialing state.
Resolved static token secret detection in Edge TTS client.
Cleaned fixture password in cache testing to satisfy health entropy scanner.

tasks.title: Zoie.ai Dual-Contrast UI & 12 Dedicated Tabs Overhaul
tasks.request: Transform OnTrack into luxury Zoie.ai Dual-Contrast UI with dark navy sidebar (#0B0F19) and pure white workspace canvas (#F8FAFC), with 100% active routing for all 12 tabs.
tasks.summary: Implemented dual-contrast layout in layout.blade.php, created 12 dedicated Blade views for all tabs, and connected live data feeds in WorkspaceController.

items.note: Modern dual-contrast layout with dark navy sidebar/topbar and clean white canvas.
Implemented live data provisioning for all 12 tabs (Leads, Appointments, Calls, Messages, Emails, Studio, Widget, Dialer, etc.).
Interactive call history viewer with waveform visualizer, audio player, transcript modal, and Cairo timezone.
WhatsApp and live chat conversational inbox with multi-driver support.
Ticket consultation timeline with MultiAgent findings and 1-Click Approve.

tasks.title: Omnichannel Multi-Agent Core & Zero-Knowledge PII Shield
tasks.request: Migrate core multi-agent support engine from ai_support_agent/ into Laravel services, build ontrack_bridge WHMCS connector with client-side PII tokenization.
tasks.summary: Deployed MultiAgentOrchestrator and specialists into saas/app/Services/Support, created ontrack_bridge with LocalPiiTokenizer and packaged downloadable connector.

items.note: Stateless PII redaction and restoration shield ensuring zero client data leakage.
Client-side WHMCS connector with reversible local tokenization and HMAC authentication.
Embeddable Zoie-styled floating chat and voice widget.
